Market Research & Reporting (20%)\n- Conduct market research on truck transportation trends and demand, analyze data, support product direction, and perform market surveys.\n- Prepare weekly and monthly work plans and reports to ensure sales targets are achieved; monitor competitors (e.g., Lalamove, GHTK).\n\n3.   "requirements_text": "Requirements:\n2 năm kinh nghiệm chuyên môn  Cao Đẳng trở lên\n\nCandidate Requirements\n- College or Bachelor's degree in Economics, Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or related fields.\n- At least 2 years of experience in a similar role, preferably in FMCG, retail, e-wallets, payment gateways, traditional logistics/transportation companies, or on-demand delivery.\n- Experience in logistics or truck transportation sales is a strong advantage.\n- Experience working with enterprise clients in industrial parks is preferred.\n- Strong ability to quickly understand and adapt to the needs of different enterprise customer segments.\n- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint). Personal transportation (motorbike or car) is required.\n- Excellent communication, persuasion, and negotiation skills.\n- Proactive, customer-focused, and results-driven.\n- Confident, dynamic, persistent, and able to work under high pressure.
